summary: A family caregiver learns that the work they already do can become a paid occupation.
realLife: Francis Adams left steel work to care for his grandfather and later learned while caring for his aunt that he could do home care professionally.
gates: Family care precedes a real opportunity for paid care work.
inGame: needs: a family caregiving history and a paid care offer.

turns.what: The caregiver takes a paid client.
turns.pulledBy: A client and suitable hours are available.
The worker is interested but cannot yet take a client.
